rotation.descriptionOn: New worker intents use the selected profiles in round-robin order. Independent workers can run on different providers simultaneously. Other roles keep the current profile.
rotation.descriptionOff: Ordered failover: workers share the current profile and switch after quota exhaustion or repeated provider failures.
rotation.warnMinProfiles: Select at least two profiles to distribute work across providers.
rotation.warnBinding: Worker has a fixed model binding, which overrides rotation. Set Worker’s model to follow the task in Agent settings to use these profiles.
rotation.warnBindingUnchecked: Worker binding could not be checked. A fixed Worker model overrides rotation; verify Agent settings.
rotation.hint: Set concurrent worker count to at least 2 in System settings before starting the task. In-flight calls keep their provider. Exhausted profiles are skipped until the chain is reset.

emptyState: When no profile is set, the task follows the agent or the global active profile.

role.skippedTooltip: Profiles before the current cursor are not picked by automatic failover
